memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild itching on elbows and knees, able to work full days supervising coffee estate, walks 2 km daily.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal).
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 0 regular (new patient).
mood: denies low mood or anxiety.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want clear skin and to keep working without flare‑ups."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
clobetasol 0.05% cream apply BD to affected areas
calcipotriol ointment apply OD to affected areas
methotrexate 7.5 mg PO once weekly
folic acid 5 mg PO daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text:

CBC: Hb 14.8 g/dL (13‑17), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4‑10), Platelets 210 x10^9/L (150‑400).
Serum creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2).
Fasting lipid profile: LDL 138 mg/dL (<100), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 162 mg/dL (<150).
CK: 110 U/L (30‑200).
Serum vitamin B12: 210 pg/mL (200‑900).
MCV: 92 fL (80‑100).
Hemoglobin: 14.8 g/dL (as above).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: skin lesions improved, occasional mild scaling; able to supervise estate, walks 3 km.
cognition: not repeated this visit (annual due).
falls: no falls, gait steady, timed up-and-go 8 seconds.
medicines: 4 regular (clobetasol, calcipotriol, methotrexate, folic acid).
mood: reports occasional frustration with skin, denies depression.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want the plaques to disappear completely."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Resting ECG: sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST‑T changes, left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No arrhythmias.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: mild flare on scalp, manageable with topical steroids; work unaffected.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw mildly abnormal).
falls: no falls, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.

carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want to keep my skin clear enough to feel comfortable in meetings."

atorvastatin 10 mg HS stopped
rosuvastatin 10 mg OD started
fenofibrate 145 mg OD continued
methotrexate 10 mg PO weekly unchanged

clobetasol 0.05% cream BD

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Dermatology, Sparsh Hospital, for recalcitrant plaque psoriasis despite topical and methotrexate therapy. Request assessment for biologic therapy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dermatology review: patient exhibits moderate plaque psoriasis PASI 8. Recommend trial of apremilast 30 mg BD after liver labs reviewed. Continue methotrexate with folic acid. Return in 8 weeks.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve started apremilast as advised. Skin looks less red but I have mild diarrhea and nausea. Also feel a bit tired in the mornings.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2026-05-10 at 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) to review apremilast tolerability and labs.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: skin lesions markedly thinner, occasional mild itching; able to work full days, walks 3.5 km.
cognition: Mini-Cog 2/5 (recall 1, clock draw abnormal) – positive screen, plan for full MoCA assessment.
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait slightly slower, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 6 regular (apremilast, methotrexate, folic acid, rosuvastatin, fenofibrate, clobetasol/calcipotriol topical). Five or more = polypharmacy – request Beers criteria review.
mood: reports mild fatigue, denies depression.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want to stay active and keep my skin under control without side effects."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: skin clear except minimal residual scaling on elbows; work unaffected, walks 4 km.
cognition: MoCA 26/30 (normal).
falls: no falls, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (apremilast 20 mg BD, methotrexate, folic acid, rosuvastatin, fenofibrate, topical steroids). Polypharmacy noted, Beers review pending.
mood: feels well, denies depression.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want to keep my skin clear and feel energetic for my estate work."
